content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

Understanding Bitcoin payments for digital downloads is crucial for creators in regions with restricted access to conventional payment platforms. Bitcoin allows for seamless transactions, enabling creators to sell their digital products directly to customers without intermediary fees. This approach not only reduces costs but also enhances financial sovereignty, allowing creators to maintain full ownership of their revenue without being subjected to the whims of third-party platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture for accepting Bitcoin payments consists of several key components working together: a hosting platform like GitHub Pages for product delivery, a backend solution using Cloudflare Workers for processing orders, and NOWPayments for handling cryptocurrency transactions. This setup ensures that once a payment is confirmed on the blockchain, the digital product is automatically delivered to the customer. Each component is designed to be low-cost and efficient, allowing creators to build a robust digital storefront without relying on traditional payment systems.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in countries where platforms like Stripe and PayPal are either unavailable or heavily restricted. It empowers individuals selling ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital products to operate independently. By eliminating the need for traditional payment processors, creators can maximize their profits, retain full control over their business, and ensure that their work reaches a global audience without barriers.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, saving you more on every sale.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of this architecture include a hosting solution (GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages), a backend for order management (Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script), and storage for product files (Google Drive or Cloudflare R2). Additionally, NOWPayments facilitates the cryptocurrency transactions, converting Bitcoin payments into USD at the time of the transaction. Each element plays a critical role in creating a seamless experience for both the seller and the buyer, ensuring that digital products are delivered promptly and securely.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your digital storefront using Bitcoin payments, start by setting up a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account for hosting. Next, configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic to process orders. Integrate NOWPayments for handling Bitcoin transactions, ensuring that your product files are stored and delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, load your products into the system, and you're ready to start selling without the need for traditional payment platforms. For a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by setting up a sovereign digital storefront that utilizes Bitcoin payments. By leveraging hosting platforms and backend solutions, you can create a fully functional sales process that eliminates reliance on conventional payment systems. This approach allows for automatic delivery of digital products while retaining more revenue.
Eliminate platform dependencies and own your digital commerce.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're interested in selling digital downloads without the constraints of traditional payment platforms, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This comprehensive package includes all six blueprints and seven templates needed to build your sovereign digital commerce stack.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
